| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- targets is null when no target is active for the date; consumed is null when nothing is logged that day.

## `get_my_nutrition_trends`

Your daily nutrition totals over the last N days (1-365, default 30) ending on endDate (default today), with averages over the days that have data and the target active on the end date, as the app's Trends screen shows them.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `nutrition:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` | integer | no |  |
| `endDate` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Days with nothing logged are left out of days and of the averages.

## `get_my_supplement_history`

Your supplement dose history over a date range (default the last 30 days, at most 90): per supplement how many doses were scheduled, taken and skipped, plus each logged dose with its status, amount and time, as the app's supplement history shows it.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `nutrition:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `to` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Only doses that have a log row are counted; a scheduled dose that was never marked is not in this history.
- The logs list is capped at 500 rows.

## `search_peptide_compounds`

Search Fysigo's peptide compound library by name or description text, optionally by category: slug, name, category, description and whether the entry is verified. This is general reference content, the same library every member sees, not your own data. At most 50 results; read one with get_peptide_compound.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `protocols:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | string | no |  |
| `category` | string | no |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Library entries are reference descriptions, not medical advice or a prescription.
- Results are capped at 50; narrow the search for more specific matches.

## `get_peptide_compound`

One compound from Fysigo's peptide library by its slug (from search_peptide_compounds): name, category, description, aliases, product forms and source vendors. General reference content, not your own data.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `protocols:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | string | yes |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- A library entry is a reference description, not medical advice or a prescription.

## `get_my_morning_checks`

Your morning check (orthostatic test) results, newest first: resting heart rate and HRV (RMSSD), peak heart rate on standing and the jump, the stabilised standing rate, recovery HRV, the parasympathetic change and the app's classification. Default the last 14, at most 60. Taking a check needs a chest strap in the app.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `body:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Only checks taken with a chest strap are stored; a wrist reading is never a morning check.

## `list_my_lab_uploads`

The blood test reports you uploaded, newest first: file name, test date, processing status (pending, processed or failed) and how many markers were read from it. Metadata only. Uploading a file happens in the app; the results themselves are in get_my_bloodwork.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `bloodwork:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- A pending upload has not been read yet; its markers are not in get_my_bloodwork until it is processed.

## `list_my_files`

The files on your record that you or your coach shared, newest first: file name, type, size, who shared it and when. Metadata only: opening or uploading a file happens in the app.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `body:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- No file contents or download links are returned.

## `get_my_language`

The language you chose for the Fysigo app: en (English) or es (Spanish), or null when you never chose one and the app follows your device. Read it before set_my_language.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `settings:read`

No arguments.

**What a result cannot tell you**

- null means no saved choice; the language you see then comes from your device or browser.

## `set_my_language`

Change the language of the Fysigo app, as the Preferences card in settings does: en (English) or es (Spanish). It applies on the next page you open.

**Reads or writes:** write · safe to repeat · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `settings:write`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | `en` \| `es` | yes |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Changes the app's language only; emails and existing content keep the language they were written in.

## `get_my_features`

The What I use switches in settings: which areas of the app (training, nutrition, body) show in your menu. A switched-off area is hidden from the menu, not deleted. Read it before set_my_features.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `settings:read`

No arguments.

**What a result cannot tell you**

- A switch only hides or shows an area in your menu; your data in that area stays.

## `set_my_features`

Show or hide areas of the app in your menu, as the What I use card in settings does. Send only the switches to change, e.g. {"nutrition": false}; the others stay as they are. Returns the full new set.

**Reads or writes:** write · safe to repeat · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `settings:write`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `features` | object | yes |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Hiding an area removes it from your menu only; nothing in it is deleted.

## `list_my_briefings`

The briefing documents your coach shared with you, as the app's Briefings screen lists them: id, title, last update and author. Read one with get_my_briefing.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `programs:read`

No arguments.

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Only briefings shared with you; at most 100 are listed.

## `get_my_briefing`

One briefing your coach shared with you, as plain text: title, author, last update and the document text (at most 20,000 characters; truncated says if it was cut). The briefingId comes from list_my_briefings.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `programs:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `briefingId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Images and layout in the briefing are not included, only its text.

## `get_my_box_schedule`

Your Box (CrossFit gym) class schedule for up to 14 days from a date (default today): each class's time, name, coach, capacity and booked count, and whether you are booked. Only for Box members. Booking and cancelling happen in the app.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `training:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `days` | integer | no |  |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Booking a class uses your membership's class credits, so booking and cancelling stay in the app.

## `get_my_box_wod`

Your Box's workout of the day for a date (default today): title, track, scoring, time cap and stimulus notes, and your logged result if you have one. Only for Box members.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `training:read`

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string | no | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |

**What a result cannot tell you**

- wod is null when the gym has not published a WOD for the date.
- Logging a WOD result happens in the app.

## `get_my_box_progress`

Your Box progress as the app's Progress screen shows it: classes attended in the last 30 days, current and best streak, PRs this year, your personal records and benchmark history. Only for Box members.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `training:read`

No arguments.

**What a result cannot tell you**

- Lists are capped at 100 entries.

## `get_my_box_membership`

Your Box membership as the app's Membership screen shows it: plan, status, class credits left and renewal date, plus your recent invoices (date, amount in cents, currency, status). Only for Box members. Paying, freezing or cancelling happen in the app.

**Reads or writes:** read · **Plan:** Personal or Coach · **Scope:** `training:read`

No arguments.

**What a result cannot tell you**

- No payment links are returned; payments, freezes and cancellations stay in the app.
- At most 24 invoices are listed.
